pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is largest on the mid-neck and upper flank, with geometries ranging from sub-rectangles to complex many-sided polygons.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes typically feature three or four intersecting pathways. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour along the cervical ridge, created by dense, short hair fibers projecting against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and the shoulder.
